posts.author: unagiootoro
posts.body:
It is a plugin that changes the movement method from mass movement to dot movement. It also supports follower display and room map. You can also set the movement unit of the event (one step movement, half step movement, etc.) in more detail.
↓ You can download it from the link below.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unagiootoro/RPGMZ/master/DotMoveSystem.js
Author:    unagi ootoro
License:  MIT

posts.author: Qrim
posts.body: Hello, I have made this work for character events as well. Is there a way that when the event chases the player it does not get stuck on walls?

posts.author: Arayell
posts.body:
Not sure if this is a matter of this plugin or the script that makes chasing player. Default RPG Maker features are suboptimal for the task. Try using GALV's Move Route extras MZ and in the event setup make either the antonomous movement custom route script to do the job, e.g. script could be:
JavaScript:
$gameMap._events[this._eventId].moveStraight( $gameMap._events[this._eventId].findDirectionTo( $gamePlayer.x, $gamePlayer.y) );
Do note that this example will make the event chase player regardless of distance, so worth doing this in combination of some proximity scripts, if you want the chase to start when the event "spots" the player instead.
